quest.title: Across the Sea
quest.description: You and Paimon prepare to investigate a ruin near Lingju Pass...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Ask the Millelith about the situation

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: Be on your guard, Traveler. Now is no time for sightseeing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, why's that? Has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: Yes. As unusual as this may sound, numerous eyewitness reports have confirmed an active Ruin Guard presence in this area, even though this is far beyond their normal area of activity.

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: Sergeant sent someone to find out just where these ancient machines might have come from. It appears that they simply left their ruin and marched off all of a sudden, for no clear reason.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So did somebody wake them up?

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: As I say, the reason is still unclear. We have very little intelligence at present.

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: Moreover... The ruin in question is of the especially spooky variety. Strange noises are often heard coming from within...

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: As such, we are not permitted to investigate until the order comes through from headquarters.

choices.text: One can never be too cautious.

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: In any case, the only sensible strategy in the meantime is to increase Millelith patrols. We must not let innocent civilians come to harm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a good point... Ruin Guards are probably pretty dangerous for regular folk...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there any way I can help?

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Wow, uh... I'm very grateful indeed for the offer, but... it just wouldn't be worth the risk.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, don't worry about that! {NICKNAME} here, {M#he}{F#she} beats up Ruin Guards for breakfast!

choices.text: I do know a little self-defense.

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Is that so...

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Well, if you're genuinely offering...

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: I did see some Ruin Guard footprints on the <color=#00E1FFFF>hillside</color>, but since then I've been too busy warning passers-by to investigate myself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Footprints, eh? Interesting... We'll take the case!

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail! On behalf of the Millelith, I salute you, Traveler. You have my gratitude. I will rendezvous with you once I have finished my patrol.

choices.text: Not to brag, but I could beat ten of you in a fight.

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Ahaha, the self-confidence of young people is an extraordinary thing...

choices.text: The Millelith... Always so inefficient.

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Sorry? Did you say something?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Was that supposed to be your impression of Master Diluc talking about the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.text: Hey, you! Check this out, isn't it awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What is he wearing?
I've never seen one this close before! Have you ever seen one?

choices.text: Yes, it's a powered-down Ruin Guard.

response.text: Um, excuse me? His name is Mr. Cyclops, actually! What sorta dumb name is "Ruin Guard"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Mr. Cyclops"? Aw, that's cute... Wait, what? Do people seriously call them that?
Yep! My brother said so. And he's the best toy seller in the whole world! It's his job to sell this kinda stuff!
Right now he's at the Institute for Toy Research in Liyue. That's where Mr. Cyclopses come from.
It's always nice to meet someone else who likes toys. So tell me, where'd you get your toy from? Must be a pretty new kind, I've never seen one that can fly and talk before!

choices.text: Paimon is not a toy, neither are Ruin Guards...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon is not a toy!

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Greetings, have you found anythi— Oh, a child...? Wh—What's the situation here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We just, y'know, found him.

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Uh-uh, you shouldn't be out here, boy. There are killing machines in the area, it's extremely dangerous.
"Killing machines"? You mean... ones that look like this?

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Precisely, and including this one. It's not moving now, but if it were to wake up, the consequences would be...
You take that back! Mr. Cyclops is not a killing machine, he's one of the good guys!

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Um... "Mr. Cyclops"?
We shouldn't be talking to this guy. If he's saying mean things about Mr. Cyclops, he's definitely a bad man.

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: I—I'm just trying to help...

choices.text: I think you've lost him...

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: Ugh, I've always been hopeless at dealing with children...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well then, why don't you get back to your normal job and leave us to do the babysitting?

response.speaker: Daipai
response.text: It seems I have no other choice... Very well, I will continue with my patrol. Please escort the child to somewhere safe, it's much too dangerous here.
Hahahaha, the mighty Mr. Cyclops scared off the bad guys once again!

choices.text: What's your name, kid?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: My name's Teucer! I came all the way from Snezhnaya to look for my brother in Liyue. But I'm all on my own, and I don't know where to find him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You came all the way from Snezhnaya!?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Oh, I think this is the part where I give you this... Here you go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is it? Looks heavy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the!?

choices.text: So much Mora!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: My brother said I should take it with me. He said, "Find a nice person to give this to, and they will take good care of Teucer."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Your brother makes a good point... Still, it's hard to believe you made it all this way armed with nothing but a few bags of Mora...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Your family must be super rich! Paimon never knew you could make so much Mora from selling toys.

choices.text: I will gladly take it!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: #Yay! Thanks, nice {M#guy}{F#lady}!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Alright, now we gotta make a pinkie promise!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: You make a pinkie promise, you keep it all your life. You break a pinkie promise, I throw you on the ice. The cold will kill the pinkie that once betrayed your friend, the frost will freeze your tongue off so you never lie again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... That one nursery rhyme kinda says all you need to know about Snezhnayan culture...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if we weren't your babysitters before, we sure as heck are now! ...But where should we look for your brother?

choices.text: Somewhere with close connections to Snezhnaya.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Snezhnaya... Ooh, how about the <color=#00E1FFFF>Northland Bank</color>?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Alright! Finally, now I get to see my brother!

choices.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Northland Bank</color>?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great idea. Alright, off we go!

choices.text: I will gladly take it! (And give it to your brother when we find him...)
So, so, so much Mora!
Where are your family?
Maybe let me handle this...
Limited edition. Jealous much?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Just 'cause you get to play with Paimon all the time does not mean that Paimon's a toy!

choices.text: Careful kid, these guys are tough.

response.text: You bet! Mr. Cyclopses are crazy strong! No bad guys can escape from these guys, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Ekaterina
dialogues.text: That seems a little inappropriate, don't you think, sir? How can you—

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Relax, once in a while can't hurt. It'll be fine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's he doing here...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Yay, my brother! I found you!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I know that voice... Why, if it isn't my little brother, Teucer! My goodness!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Haha... What a nice surprise, Teucer! I thought I would have to wait till I return home before seeing you again...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: How are the others — sister Tonia and brother Anthon? Is everybody keeping well?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: They miss you a lot! Tonia prays for you every day at dinner...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: ...Wait a second, what are you doing here in Liyue, Teucer? How have I not heard anything about this?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Well... what happened was... I saw a boat that looked like it was selling toys, so obviously I thought you were on board...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: And then when I got off I just kept walking and walking... and then, I found a Mr. Cyclops!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: #Mr. Cyclops scared off a bad guy, and then I found this nice {M#guy}{F#lady} to help me come look for you...

choices.text: So Teucer's a stowaway!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And also... Teucer is Childe's brother!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool! Suddenly, Paimon doesn't feel so bad about taking Teucer's money!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Teucer, what you did was extremely dangerous... I'm so happy to see you, really I am, but please... Promise me you won't do anything like this ever again...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Okay, I promise... Please don't be mad at me...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm not mad at you. I just care about your safety, that's all.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If you hadn't met these nice people, things could have been a lot more dangerous for you, Teucer. I hope you said a big thank-you to them?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Yep! I always remember my pleases and thank-yous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so you did notice we were here, you were just ignoring us. Gotcha.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hahaha, forgive me, it's always family first where I'm from. Don't take it personally.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I know we've had our differences up to now, but... a few minor quibbles aside, we get on quite well, don't you think?

choices.text: Do you mean that, or are you just keeping up appearances?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Heh... Come on, you know I'm just a pawn in all of that. Just doing my part. As for who wins, who loses, and how each side deals with the consequences... I prefer to leave all that up to the ones playing the game.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm much more interested in who wins and who loses when it comes to our little sparring matches.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Sounds like you're ready to get your butt kicked again?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hah! You're forgetting something about me — I, Tartaglia, spend every second getting stronger. Don't expect to have it quite so easy next time.

choices.text: I've also come a long way since then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, you aren't gonna fight now are you?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hahaha... Maybe not right now. Not while my kid brother is watching.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: #Why do you wanna fight the nice {M#guy}{F#lady}? Are you guys enemies?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #No, not at all! {NICKNAME}, allow me to formally express my sincerest gratitude for taking care of my darling brother. His safety matters very much to me.

choices.text: I'm still keeping my eye on you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Um, so anyway, Paimon has a question...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Teucer said something about you being a toy seller... What's all that about? Aren't you supposed to be one of the Fatui's Harb—

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ahem! Um... Yes, about that...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Shh, look, I only told him that so that he'll look up to me. In the eyes of a child, working with toys must be the best job imaginable, right?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I don't want my family to have anything to do with the Fatui's... or should I say, Snezhnaya's... darker side.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: The older ones already know that I serve the Tsaritsa. But Teucer is still so young, and in his eyes...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ahem. As I was saying... I remain Snezhnaya's greatest expatriate toy seller, currently attached to the Liyue Branch of our Institute for Toy Research!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: That's right! My brother's the greatest! He's Mr. Cyclops' bestest friend!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Just humor me in front of Teucer, if you would be so kind...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ah, yes. Ekaterina. I will deal with the issue of that outstanding payment right away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Slinking off, are we?

response.speaker: Ekaterina
response.text: But Master Childe, would it not be a little improper to ask you to deal with... debt collection?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: A bet is a bet, isn't it? And if you lose a bet with an agent... Well, you might as well get a little exercise out of it.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Are you going off to sell toys now?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #That's right! As much as I'd love to catch up a little longer, Teucer, duty calls! I'm sure {M#Mr. Nice Guy}{F#Ms. Nice Lady} here will be happy to keep you company while I'm out, though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, so we still need to keep babysitting for you?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: #Sure! I really like this {M#guy}{F#lady}, and anyway {M#he}{F#she} made a pinkie promise to take good care of me!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ah! Well, it sounds like Teucer really likes you, and that you've already made a pinkie promise to take good care of him anyway.

choices.text: (They're ganging up on me...) ...Okay, sure.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Then I'm in your debt. Here, take this as Teucer's entertainment fund. I want him to have a good time while he's in Liyue, so take him anywhere he wants.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If need be, you may find me by the river near <color=#00E1FFFF>Qingxu Pool</color>. I'll see you both around!

choices.text: Okay, we'll do it. For Teucer.
Concern for your family's well-being. That I can understand.
Ready whenever you are.
You've got a lot of nerve...
...Teucer is Childe's brother!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's one down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep looking around. Maybe we'll find some more.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And here's another one. Yep, seems the Ruin Guards did come out for a walk after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The trail of Ruin Guard footprints leads us here, to... Ah! A Ruin Guard! Over there!

dialogues.speaker: Daipai
dialogues.text: I must continue with my patrol now. Let's rendezvous shortly.
